map.CCC=应收账款周转天数(DSO)+存货周转天数(DIH)−应付账款周转天数(D: CCC = days sales outstanding (DSO) + days inventory held (DIH) − days payable outstanding (DPO); a larger DPO shortens the cycle, but supplier terms cannot be stretched indefinitely.
